UK statement at the UN Security Council, 10 July 2026, delivered by Ambassador Kate Foster, UK Deputy Permanent Representative to the UN:
- The UK condemned the recent Iranian attacks in the region and on commercial shipping
- The UK called for de-escalation and a return to diplomacy
- The UK stands ready to support efforts to help translate the US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding into a lasting diplomatic settlement
Headline: "We stand with our partners in calling for de-escalation and a return to diplomacy: UK statement at the UN Security Council"
